headline: Clarification Sought From Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
body:
The Exchange has sought clarification from Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd on November 2, 2026, with reference to news appeared in https://www.thehindu.com/ dated October 30, 2026 quoting "India orders Sun Pharma to halt eye-care drug production at plant after quality lapses" .

The reply is awaited.
